long_biography.plain_text:
W Marine began with a single Panamax bulk carrier before Yiannis V. Sarantitis developed it into an integrated ownership and management platform. The company expanded through a mix of new construction, shipyard resales and second-hand acquisitions, retaining a concentration in Panamax, Kamsarmax and post-Panamax dry-bulk tonnage.

Sarantitis continues to set the ownership direction while professional managers lead day-to-day operations. The fleet-renewal programme has widened into Ultramax bulk carriers and feeder container ships, showing a willingness to move beyond the company’s original size range. His long connection with Norway also shaped a public role in Piraeus, where he became Norway’s honorary consul and received a royal order for that service.

uncertainties.detail: Yiannis Ch. Sarantitis is the distinct chairman and chief executive of SARMED Logistics. His official company profile and public LinkedIn result describe logistics leadership and a different professional history. None of those roles, affiliations or education details has been transferred to Yiannis V. Sarantitis of W Marine.

Vassilis Sarantitis is the subject's father and a separate lawyer and former politician. The Piraeus Bar's Ioannis Vasileiou Sarantitis form supplies a patronymic, while professional maritime records use Ioannis V. Sarantitis. The dossier proposes only the attested initial V. and does not import the father's offices or biography.

The upstream record gives 4 February 1972. A US-format legal directory renders the same digits as April 2, 1972, apparently reversing day and month, and no strong independent birth record was found. The dossier neither corrects nor re-proposes the existing date.

A legal-directory profile names Athens, Greece, but its birth-date rendering is demonstrably ambiguous and no Tier 1 or Tier 2 source reviewed supplies the birthplace. Place of birth and birth country therefore remain blank rather than being inferred from Greek nationality or residence.

W Marine is directly documented as Sarantitis's own foundation and current company. Self-made — advantaged start is a medium-confidence inference because his established family law firm supplied a strong maritime, commercial and professional platform, but the shipping company's seed capital and the precise value of that advantage are not public.

Sarantitis has material legal and property interests, but current ownership reporting, newbuilding activity and business profiles consistently centre on W Marine. Shipping & Maritime is therefore used for Primary Industry without implying that every private asset has been valued.

The upstream LinkedIn URL could not be fetched publicly during this review and search results contain several same-name Greek executives. It is retained as an existing input value but is not used as evidence, duplicated as a proposal or conflated with the separately indexed SARMED profile.
No identity-secure personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was found. Only the official W Marine company website meets the proposal threshold.

Commercial shipowner captures Sarantitis's defining role, Dry-bulk shipping captures the specific operating sector, Lawyer captures a separate enduring profession and Commercial real estate captures a separately founded material investment business. Commercial ship management is omitted because it substantially overlaps with the more informative dry-bulk sector tag.

The existing biography identifies the right person but gives an age that has already dated, an obsolete commercial-fleet count and a W Real Estate chairmanship contradicted by later corporate reporting. The proposed biography keeps the durable founder, legal and property identities while excluding private-yacht and family-dispute material.
